name: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment
summary: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment is a crate of high-grade metal prepared specifically for the smith Jordan Stilwell. Acquired as part of a paladin's sacred trials, it provides the essential stock needed to forge a holy weapon of virtue.

sections.title: A Smith's Materials
sections.body: When Jordan Stilwell set out to forge a weapon worthy of a dedicated paladin, ordinary stock would not suffice. The blacksmith required an assortment of rare and exacting components: a Purified Kor Gem, sturdy Whitestone Oak lumber, his own lost smithing hammer, and a specialized shipment of refined ore. This consignment represents the metal foundation for that sacred labor, brought to Ironforge to complete the Test of Righteousness.

faq.q: What is Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment used for?
aliases: what does jordan do with ore
faq.answer: The refined ore is delivered to Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge as one of four key components required to forge a masterwork weapon for paladins undertaking the Test of Righteousness.
The shipment is arranged through Bailor, who oversees the refining and dispatching of the specialist metal needed by Jordan Stilwell.

faq.q: Why does Jordan need this specific shipment?
aliases: why cant jordan use regular iron
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell intends to craft a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, demanding superior materials beyond ordinary forge scraps. This specially processed metal ensures the blade or hammer head possesses the balance and purity worthy of a holy knight.

angles.text: Procuring this refined shipment tests a paladin's patience and dedication, serving as one of the physical trials required to craft their symbolic weapon of the Light.
Every artisan understands that masterwork forging requires flawless, carefully prepared ingots rather than raw field ore.
